# telnyx_compute_actor (Data Source)

A stateful compute actor type.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `owner_function_id` (String) ID of the function that owns and ships this actor type. Empty when the type is unowned.
- `placement` (Attributes) Last deployment fan-out report, not a live probe. Omitted on actor types without a placement-aware deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--placement))
- `record_type` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--placement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `placement`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--placement--cluster_results))
- `clusters` (List of String) Public regions with successful deployment
- `excluded_clusters` (List of String)
- `observed_at` (String) Optional ISO-8601 millisecond timestamp
- `partial` (Boolean)
- `policy` (String)
- `unchecked_clusters` (List of String)

<a id="nestedatt--placement--cluster_results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `placement.cluster_results`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String) Public region, or unknown when no mapping exists
- `error` (String)
- `error_code` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `success` (Boolean)
